summary: Per-frame AI driver race-state update (called from MainGameTickUpdate): recomputes and wraps the driver's track distance projection, enforces pit-lane speed limits with stop-go penalties and monetary fines, detects corner cutting and wrong-way driving, manages cut-track/blue-flag penalty timers, and drives pit-entry selection based on nearby vehicle proximity.

operations.description: Derive vehicle context base v3 from this[0]+12 and load vehicle block v5; compute per-vehicle track distance via DistanceProjectionCalc(v3).
Store computed track distance into this[5] (race track position/progress field).
Skip distance wrap while this[5] holds the -1.0 sentinel (guard:0).
Wrap track distance with FloatWrapTableInterpolation; re-wrap this[5] when distance >= 0.666.
Entering pit lane: session pit-lane flag at obj+0x344C is set.
Pit-lane entry transition: set byte flag this[42] and clear speed-penalty accumulator this[43] when previously not in pit lane.
Accumulate pit-lane speed excess into this[43] as (speed magnitude - flt_8ACFB4) * delta_time while the excess is positive.
Pit-lane exit: if accumulated speed penalty this[43] > 7.5 and penalties are enabled (dword_7CEF84).
Racing mode (dword_7C56A4 == 7): apply fixed stop-go penalty of 10s for aSpeedingInPitl.
Other modes: compute monetary fine via CRTFtol((this[43]-7.5)*0.025)*500 + 1500 and apply it through sub_4BBA90(this, aSpeedingInPitl, fine).
Project vehicle position onto the track segment direction to compute lateral offset v68, clamped by track half-widths (v5+104/108).
Query corner-cut tracking enablement via sub_4BC340(this).
Corner-cut resolution active: byte flag this[45] (offset 180) is set and lateral offset < 1.0.
Track corner-cut severity: keep minimum ForceDirectionProjection in this[51], accumulate this[50] += delta_time.
Estimate gained distance from the corner cut via sub_4F01B0, lap/segment deltas and flt_5EA408; build the speed compensation into the corner-cut timing value.
Normalize the direction vector and compute corner-cut depth v66 against track boundary vectors (v5+164/168/172).
Corner-cut violation: depth v66 > 1.75 and penalties enabled; repeat count this[52] > 1 or depth > 2.75 (guard:2).
Apply aCutTrack penalty: stop-go of 10s in racing mode, otherwise a warning via WarningHandler(this, aCutTrack).
Increment cut-track counter this[52] and set flag this[24]=1; when the lap will not count, look up aLapWillNotCoun in the string table and render it as a message.
Begin corner-cut tracking when lateral offset > 2.5: snapshot lap this[47], segment value this[48], projection this[49], reset accumulators, set the in-progress flag.
When corner-cut tracking is not enabled, clear the in-progress flag this[45].
Wrong-way check: read the direction block pointer at v5+272, project the block offset onto the segment direction; if negative accumulate this[44] += -offset * delta_time / |dir|.
Wrong-way warning: when the accumulator crosses 10, look up aWrongWay and render it; when a rival is on the same lap and the driver is moving forward, raise DisplayMessage0x11c.
Wrong-way disqualification when the accumulator crosses 125 and penalties are enabled.
Early-return guard: skip pit-selection logic when the session pit-lane flag is set, mode dword_7C56A8 != 5, or lateral offset >= 8.0.
Exit path (LABEL_120) resets blue-flag timer this[55] to 0.0 before returning.
Compute pit-proximity thresholds: distance base 37.0/87.0 by mode plus 3.0 blue-flag bonus; time-window base 0.8/1.9 plus 0.2 bonus.
Iterate all dword_5C329C vehicles, skipping self (this[1]); compute wrapped track-distance delta and test each candidate's proximity.
Candidate qualifies in a mode-specific way (racing: rival behind and off the driver's lap; non-racing: rival flagged) and the lateral gap is within the time window.
Record the pit candidate: set blue-flag flag this[53] and the nearest candidate index this[54].
When no candidate, the recorded index changed, or mode != 7: clear pit-selection flags via ClearPitSelectionFlags(5, context) whenever the timer is nonzero.
Advance the pit-selection state machine (dword_5EB978) with events 1/2/3 on timer transitions at 0/10/20 seconds.
Accumulate blue-flag timer this[55]; when it exceeds 30 and penalties are enabled, apply the ignored-blue-flag stop-go penalty, show the message via sub_41A720, and reset the timer.

clean_pseudocode: if (in_pit_lane) { this[42]=1; if (speed - flt_8ACFB4 > 0) this[43] += excess * dt; }

else if (this[42]) { this[42]=0; if (this[43] > 7.5 && penalties_enabled) { if (mode==7) StopGoPenalty(aSpeedingInPitl, 10); else sub_4BBA90(this, aSpeedingInPitl, CRTFtol((this[43]-7.5)*0.025)*500+1500); } }
if (corner_cut_enabled(this)) { if (in_progress && lateral < 1.0) { penalize/warn aCutTrack; maybe show lap-will-not-count; } else if (lateral > 2.5) begin_corner_cut_snapshot(); }
wrong_way: accumulate this[44]; warn at 10; disqualify at 125;
pit selection: scan dword_5C329C vehicles, find candidate, drive PitSelectionStateMachine timer events, blue-flag penalty at 30s.
